tools/zr_icf_url_list.title: ZR_ICF_URL_LIST: every ICF service URL as a flat list for the CPI team
tools/zr_icf_url_list.req: The CPI integration team needs the complete list of valid service URLs of the system. SICF shows only a tree expanded node by node, so a report must produce one row per URL for export to a spreadsheet.
tools/zr_icf_url_list.chal: ICFSERVICE stores each node with its parent GUID, so the report walks the parent chain to rebuild the path and decide whether the whole chain is active. How virtual hosts are stored is marked as an assumption.
tools/zr_icf_url_list.ai: Built ZR_ICF_URL_LIST (298 lines, 02/11/26): one URL per row with active-chain and end-node flags, optional base URL prefix and ALV export. Wrote the shipping steps, text elements, run variants and a first-run check for the virtual-host assumption.
tools/zr_icf_url_list.man: The consultant pastes the report into SE38, maintains the text elements and performs the first-run check.
tools/zr_icf_url_list.res: A read-only report that lists only URLs that answer by default. Orphan subtrees and chains deeper than 64 nodes are marked rather than dropped, and the virtual-host assumption is guarded in code.

research/copilot-btp-mcp.title: Research and proposal: creating SAP documents from Teams through the BTP MCP Gateway
research/copilot-btp-mcp.objects: API_PURCHASEREQ_PROCESS_SRV (OData API), API_PURCHASEORDER_PROCESS_SRV (OData API), BAPI_PR_CREATE (BAPI), BAPI_PO_CREATE1 (BAPI), BAPI_PO_RELEASE (BAPI), ZMCP_PO_CREATE (RFC wrapper)
research/copilot-btp-mcp.req: Business users want to raise requisitions, create and release purchase orders and maintain vendors from Microsoft Teams under their own identity and authorisations. Management needs options, a recommendation, costs and a plan for a proof of concept.
research/copilot-btp-mcp.chal: Several connection routes had to be compared against identity propagation into on-premise ABAP, SAP API Policy and licensing. Several vendor pages were not reachable from the research network and were read through public mirrors and search summaries.
research/copilot-btp-mcp.ai: Delivered research notes with sources, a management proposal v1.0 (seven options, architecture, compliance and licensing, security controls, five-phase plan, costs, risks, six decisions, build guide), a two-page connection brief and a generator for the Word versions.
research/copilot-btp-mcp.man: The consultant framed the two routes to compare and is named author of the proposal and brief. The verification of vendor pages and the six decisions rest with the leadership team.
research/copilot-btp-mcp.res: Management has an options comparison, a recommendation, a cost outline and a five-phase plan to decide on the proof of concept. Every claim carries a source and a read-before-write design limits risk.
